purpose: Authoritative applied-migration evidence. The relation is introduced only by a separately approved bootstrap migration.
ordering_rule: Canonical migration manifest order is append-only; applied records must match that order exactly.
concurrency_rule: A runner must hold one database-scoped advisory lock before evaluating or writing ledger state.
partial_apply_rule: A transaction outcome other than committed blocks subsequent application and requires an explicit forward-fix or approved recovery decision.
retry_rule: Retry is allowed only after the gate confirms that the same immutable id and checksum are not already committed.
